title: PrimitiveCard
description: Required shape for every card under cards/computation/. The schema is enforced by L24 (complexity) and by tool_create_card when the target category is computation.

name.description: Snake-case unique identifier of the primitive.

statement.description: One-paragraph claim of what this primitive is and does.

time.description: Big-O or operational bound, e.g. 'O(n log n)', 'O(1) amortized', '~250 cycles'.

energy.description: Optional energy claim, e.g. 'O(n)' joules or 'constant'.

alternatives.description: Names of other primitive cards that solve the same problem with different trade-offs.

composes_with.description: Names of primitives this card commonly stacks with (per composition_rules).

witnesses.description: Names of witness procedures that mechanically check this card's claims (correctness tests, complexity benchmarks, property tests, theorem proofs).

variants.description: At least one language/format variant of the primitive; the variant_contract card defines which extensions are recognized.
